question: Which of the following Five-Year Plans was based on the Mahalanobis model?
solution: The correct answer is __**Second Five-Year Plan**__ ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** • The **second five-year plan's** main emphasis was on industry, particularly heavy industry. To achieve the target of a **25%** increase in national income, **rapid industrialisation **was adopted. • Using the **Mahalanobis model,** the **second five-year plan** is created. The **USSR model** was Indianized by **PC Mahalanobis**, the founder of the Indian Statistical Institute and a close Nehru ally. • This strategy is acknowledged to have produced the **statistical underpinnings** for state-directed investments and the **philosophical** foundations for the **licencing **raj through an intricate input-output model. • This model suggested that in order to achieve **higher long-term growth**, the Indian economy should concentrate more of a focus on **heavy industries.** • The** Industrial Policy Resolution** of **1956** and India's **second five-year plan,** which paved the ground for the growth of the public sector and the licencing raj, were both established using this idea.
